meta.name: ai-video-generation
meta.description: Generate AI videos with Google Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan, Grok and 40+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse 1.0, Wan 2.5, Grok Imagine Video, OmniHuman, Fabric, HunyuanVideo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, video upscaling, foley sound. Use for: social media videos, marketing content, explainer videos, product demos, AI avatars. Triggers: video generation, ai video, text to video, image to video, veo, animate image, video from image, ai animation, video generator, generate video, t2v, i2v, ai video maker, create video with ai, runway alternative, pika alternative, sora alternative, kling alternative, seedance, happyhorse

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成视频，支持40多种AI模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成社交媒体或营销视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate videos from text or images using 40+ AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create social media or marketing videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行调用 40 多种 AI 视频模型，根据文字、图片或参考视频生成、编辑、配音视频，并支持数字人动画。
howto.when: 当你要求生成视频、将图片变为视频、编辑视频或创建数字人时触发。

say.text: 用 Veo 生成一段无人机飞越森林的视频。
把这张图片变成动画，添加海浪声。
给这段视频加上脚步声和鸟鸣声。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call over 40 AI video models via command line to generate, edit, and add sound to videos from text, images, or references, and create avatar animations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a video, animate an image, edit a video, or create an AI avatar.

say_en.text: Generate a drone shot flying over a forest using Veo.
say_en.note: Claude will run Veo 3.1 Fast model.

say_en.text: Animate this image and add ocean wave sounds.
say_en.note: Claude will use Seedance 2.0 with audio.

say_en.text: Add footsteps and birds chirping to this video.
